component.name: Smart Connect
component.summary: Connect, mirror, and control your Motorola phone from Linux

description.p: Smart Connect for Linux is a feature-rich, high-performance companion app for Motorola phones. It pairs seamlessly with your phone to provide screen mirroring, independent app streaming, cross-device input control, notification sync, clipboard synchronization, and virtual display extension.

ul.li: Screen Mirroring: Low-latency WebRTC video stream of your phone's screen.
App Streaming: Stream individual phone apps into standalone Linux desktop windows.
Cross Control: Move your mouse pointer and keyboard seamlessly between your PC and phone.
Clipboard Synchronization: Instant bi-directional clipboard sharing between PC and phone.
Notification Sync & Reply: Receive and reply to Android notifications directly from your desktop.
Extend Display: Use your phone or tablet as an external monitor for your Linux PC.
Phone Camera as Webcam: High-definition webcam streaming using v4l2loopback.
File Sharing: Fast bidirectional file browsing and media transfer.

description.p: Initial public release of Smart Connect for Linux, featuring Apple Pro Dark Monochrome UI redesign, screen mirroring, app streaming, Cross Control, file sharing, and virtual display.
